question_cn: 以下哪些是「己方空间受到挤压」的典型视觉信号？
question_en: Which are typical signs that your position is cramped for space?

options.text_cn: 象被己方兵锁在原位无法移动；马被迫走迂回路线；棋子堆挤在一侧
options.text_en: A bishop is blocked by its own pawns, a knight must take a roundabout route, and pieces are crowded on one side.

options.text_cn: 己方棋子发展很快，所有棋子都出动了
options.text_en: Your pieces develop quickly and are all active.

options.text_cn: 对方有一个孤立兵，空间与此无关
options.text_en: The opponent has an isolated pawn; this is unrelated to space.

options.text_cn: 己方吃掉了对方的一个兵，位置改善
options.text_en: You captured an enemy pawn and improved your position.

explanation_cn: 空间挤压的三大视觉信号：①「坏象」——己方象被本方兵封住，无法沿对角线活动（法国防御中黑方c8象被e6+d5锁死是典型）；②马被迫绕路——正常发展格被对方兵占据，马只能走迂回路线（如原本走f6的马被迫改走e7）；③棋子拥挤——多个子力都想去中心却没有空间，互相碍事。出现这些信号，说明己方正承受空间压力。
explanation_en: Three visual signs of a cramped position are: a bad bishop blocked by its own pawns; a knight forced onto a detour because its normal development squares are occupied; and pieces crowded together with too little room to maneuver. These signs indicate that your side is under spatial pressure.
